message: The other day, I was rummaging through my pantry and found a can of beans from 2010. Now, I love beans, but I think we can all agree that some things just don’t age like fine wine! 😄 It got me thinking about how important it is to be prepared for the unexpected. Having a well-stocked kit is a bit like keeping a secret stash of your favorite snacks — you never know when you might need it, and it could save you a lot of last-minute scrambles. What’s your go-to item for staying ready?
